places.name: Sanuki Udon
buy: Kake udon, hot clear dashi broth (かけうどん)
Kitsune udon with sweet tofu (きつねうどん)
Wakame or plain udon in hot broth, ask for no tempura (わかめうどん)
places.avoid: Skip the fried tempura toppings, curry udon and cold/iced drinks; ask for no shichimi pepper.
places.notes: Assembly-line Sanuki-style udon shop opened Jan 2024; listings and reviews through Dec 2025 show it operating. Hours from third-party listings (11:30-20:30 daily); Instagram @sanukiudonusa.

places.name: Raku SoHo
buy: Kake udon, hot clear broth (かけうどん)
Niku udon, beef in hot broth (肉うどん)
Kitsune udon (きつねうどん)
Hot green tea (お茶)
places.avoid: Skip curry udon, tempura, mentaiko and anything spicy; have the broth warm, not cold bukkake style.
places.notes: Phone (212) 989-4797. Hours conflict across listings: Toast ordering page says closed Monday, 12:00-21:30 other days; Franki/Atly list Monday 17:00-21:30 and later Fri/Sat close. Reported cash only. Small room, often a wait at dinner.

places.name: Omen Azen
buy: Omen udon in hot dashi broth with vegetables (おめん)
Steamed or simmered vegetables (野菜の炊き合わせ)
Plain rice (ご飯)
places.avoid: Pricey Kyoto-style spot; skip the tempura, sashimi with wasabi, and sake; order the udon hot not cold.
places.notes: Phone (212) 925-8923. Dinner only; sources disagree on Sunday/Monday (one says closed Su+Mo, another daily 17:00-22:00, OpenTable says 18:00-23:00). Reviews dated May 2025 show it operating.

places.name: Ootoya Union Square
buy: Grilled salted mackerel set with rice and miso soup (しまほっけ/さば塩焼き定食)
Chicken and egg rice bowl, mild (親子丼)
Steamed chawanmushi egg custard (茶碗蒸し)
Hot soba or udon in clear broth (温かいそば/うどん)
places.avoid: Skip the fried katsu, karaage, spicy miso dishes and iced tea; ask for hot tea.
places.notes: Phone (212) 473-4300. Japanese teishoku (set meal) chain; Resy article Jan 2026 lists this branch as open. Hours above are typical Ootoya hours and NOT confirmed for 2026 — call ahead; may close between lunch and dinner.

places.name: Saigon Shack
buy: Chicken pho, clear broth (phở gà)
Beef pho with rare steak, clear broth (phở tái)
Plain steamed rice (cơm trắng)
places.avoid: Skip the fried spring rolls, banh mi with chili/pickles and Vietnamese iced coffee; leave out the lime, hoisin and sriracha on the side.
places.notes: Phone (212) 228-0588. Cash only per Time Out. Hours from Time Out and Franki agree; other listings show 11:00-22:00 or 11:00-20:00. Busy with NYU students, small room.

places.name: Tim Ho Wan
places.neighborhood: NoHo / East Village border (4th Ave at E 10th-11th)
buy: Congee with pork and century egg (皮蛋瘦肉粥)
Steamed rice rolls, plain or with shrimp (腸粉)
Steamed shrimp dumplings (蝦餃)
Steamed chicken with mushroom on rice (北菇滑雞飯)
places.avoid: Skip the baked BBQ pork buns, fried items, chili oil and anything with XO sauce; ask for hot tea.
places.notes: Phone (212) 228-2800. Official USA store page snippet shows 11:00-21:00 seven days, but a partial listing shows Wed/Thu 11:30-20:30 — call to confirm. Michelin-listed Hong Kong dim sum chain; lines on weekends.

places.name: Uncle Ted's Modern Chinese
places.neighborhood: Greenwich Village (E 8th St near University Pl)
buy: Wonton soup, clear broth (雲吞湯)
Build-your-own steamed chicken or fish with steamed vegetables, sauce on side (清蒸雞/魚配蔬菜)
Plain steamed white rice (白飯)
places.avoid: Skip General Tso's, sesame chicken, hot & sour soup, Szechuan dishes and anything fried or in brown sauce.
places.notes: Phone (212) 777-1395. Original 163 Bleecker St location destroyed by fire May 2021; relocated to 36-38 E 8th St. OpenTable shows diner reviews dated 2026 and hours 11:00-21:15 daily, but some directories still show old address — confirm by phone. Menu has a 'choose protein + steamed vegetables' option that suits a bland diet.

places.name: Fay Da Bakery
places.neighborhood: Greenwich Village (6th Ave at W 3rd St)
buy: Plain steamed pork bun or vegetable bun (叉燒包/菜包, steamed not baked)
Soft plain milk bread or raisin roll (牛奶包)
Egg custard tart, mild (蛋撻)
Soy milk, ask if hot (豆漿)
places.avoid: Skip the fried sesame balls, curry puffs, iced bubble tea and heavily sweet cream cakes.
places.notes: Phone (212) 255-9888. Hong Kong-style bakery chain; listings give 07:00-20:30 or 07:00-21:00 daily. Steamed buns and hot soy milk availability vary by time of day — buns sell out late afternoon.

places.name: Breads Bakery (Union Square)
places.neighborhood: Union Square (north side, ~12 min from WSP)
buy: Plain challah or sliced white/whole wheat bread (challah)
Plain croissant or brioche roll
Oatmeal or porridge when on the breakfast menu
Chamomile or herbal tea, hot
places.avoid: Skip the chocolate babka, rugelach, coffee and anything with citrus glaze or tomato.
places.notes: Phone (212) 633-2253. Hours from the official site (07:00-20:00 daily). Flagship with seating; good for plain bread to take home.

places.name: Bagel Bob's on York
places.neighborhood: Greenwich Village (University Pl at E 9th-10th St)
buy: Plain or egg bagel, toasted, with butter or plain cream cheese
Plain bagel with egg and cheese (no sauce)
Oatmeal when available
places.avoid: Skip the everything/onion/garlic bagels, lox with capers, coffee and iced drinks.
places.notes: Hours (06:00-19:00 daily) come from a 2017 NYU News guide; reviews from Oct 2025 confirm it is operating. Historically cash only; 10% NYU student discount reported. Confirm hours by phone.

places.name: Waverly Diner
places.neighborhood: Greenwich Village (6th Ave at Waverly Pl)
buy: Oatmeal with banana, hot
Chicken noodle or chicken rice soup
Plain toast or English muffin with butter
Poached or scrambled eggs with plain toast; chamomile tea
places.avoid: Skip the fries, burgers, Greek salad with tomato, orange juice, coffee and sodas.
places.notes: Phone (212) 675-3181. Most sources (NYC Tourism, 2024 Village View, photo blogs) say open 24 hours; TripAdvisor shows 07:00-23:00 and some delivery apps show shorter windows — call late at night to confirm. Classic Greek diner, large menu.

places.name: Washington Square Diner
buy: Oatmeal with banana
Chicken noodle soup
Plain toast or bagel with butter; scrambled eggs
Hot herbal tea
places.avoid: Skip fried sides, burgers, tomato-based soups, citrus juices and coffee.
places.notes: Phone (212) 533-9306. Hours conflict badly: several listings say open 24 hours, Sideways/WhereYouEat say 06:00-24:00, NYU News (2022) said 07:00-23:00. Reviews dated Aug and Nov 2025 confirm it is operating. Student discount historically honored.

places.name: Sunrise Mart SoHo
places.neighborhood: SoHo (Broome St at Wooster, ~13 min from WSP)
buy: Onigiri rice balls, salmon or umeboshi (おにぎり)
Instant udon and dashi packets for home (うどん・だし)
Plain steamed rice packs and natto-free bento (ご飯パック)
Hot meals from the deli counter before 19:00 (お弁当)
places.avoid: Skip the spicy mentaiko onigiri, fried karaage bento, mochi ice cream and canned iced coffee.
places.notes: Phone (212) 219-0033. The East Village (Stuyvesant St) Sunrise Mart closed in April 2022; this SoHo branch is the surviving downtown store. A Sept 2025 blog and user listings give 11:00-20:00 daily, hot food counter until about 19:00. One MapQuest listing shows 'Closed' but has June 2025 reviews — verify by phone.

places.name: Whole Foods Market Union Square
places.address: 4 Union Square S, New York, NY 10003
buy: Hot soup bar: chicken noodle or plain vegetable broth soups
Oatmeal from the hot bar (mornings) and bananas
Plain rice, steamed vegetables and roast chicken from the hot bar
Chamomile and ginger tea, plain bread and bagels
places.avoid: Skip the spicy and tomato-based soups, kombucha, citrus and the cold-pressed juices.
places.notes: Phone (212) 673-5388. Time Out and other listings agree on 08:00-23:00 daily; one ride-share listing shows a 21:00 close — check the Whole Foods store locator. Upstairs seating area for eating hot-bar food.

places.name: Trader Joe's (14th & 3rd)
buy: Steel-cut or instant oatmeal, bananas
Frozen plain rice, chicken broth and miso soup
Plain bagels, sliced white bread, rice cakes
Chamomile and ginger tea bags
places.avoid: Skip the spicy frozen meals, Everything But the Bagel seasoning, sparkling water and citrus-heavy snacks.
places.notes: Hours 08:00-21:00 daily per third-party listing (most NYC Trader Joe's keep 08:00-21:00); not confirmed on the official site. Long lines in the evening; this is the original 14th St store, a second one is at 14th St & Avenue A.

places.name: Westside Market NYC (3rd Ave)
places.neighborhood: East Village / Union Square border (3rd Ave at E 12th)
buy: Hot soup bar: chicken noodle, chicken and rice
Hot food bar: plain rice, steamed vegetables, roast chicken
Oatmeal and bananas; plain bread and bagels
Herbal tea
places.avoid: Skip the fried and spicy hot-bar items, tomato soups, sodas and iced coffee.
places.notes: Opened 2014 as a 24/7 store and an aggregator still lists it as open 24 hours, but no 2025-2026 source confirms overnight hours — it may close around midnight now. Call ahead late at night. A second Westside Market is at 180 3rd Ave (16th-17th St).

places.name: Morton Williams (Bleecker St)
places.neighborhood: Greenwich Village (Bleecker at LaGuardia Pl, NYU)
buy: Bananas, oatmeal, plain bread and bagels
Canned or boxed chicken broth and plain rice
Self-serve hot buffet: plain rice, steamed vegetables, plain chicken
Chamomile tea
places.avoid: Skip the fried buffet items, spicy dishes, sodas and citrus juices.
places.notes: Closest full supermarket to Washington Square Park. An aggregator lists it as open 24 hours and the chain says 6 Manhattan stores are 24/7, but this branch is not individually confirmed — verify. Accepts EBT for hot food; no customer bathroom; crowded during the school year.

places.name: CVS Pharmacy (65 5th Ave, 24-hour store)
places.neighborhood: Greenwich Village / Union Square (5th Ave at 14th St)
buy: Antacids (Tums, Pepcid/famotidine, omeprazole)
Plain crackers, instant oatmeal, bananas
Chamomile and ginger tea bags
Electrolyte drinks (non-carbonated)
places.avoid: Skip the sodas, chips, chocolate and citrus juices; antacids are not a substitute for seeing a doctor if symptoms persist.
places.notes: 24-hour status applies to the store only: the pharmacy counter opens 09:00 and closes 13:30-14:00 for lunch (evening close not captured, call). CVS store #10612. Official store page lists store and photo open 24 hours; pharmacy opens 09:00 with a 13:30-14:00 lunch closure (evening close not captured — call). Nearest confirmed 24-hour drugstore to NYU. The Walgreens at 1 Union Square S (store until 23:00) and CVS 158 Bleecker are closer alternatives with shorter hours.

places.name: CVS Pharmacy (158 Bleecker St)
buy: Antacids (Tums, famotidine, omeprazole)
Saltine crackers, instant oatmeal
Chamomile and ginger tea
Non-carbonated electrolyte drinks
places.avoid: Skip sodas, chips, chocolate and citrus juices.
places.notes: Not a late-night option (closes 20:00 weekdays, 18:00 weekends); use the 65 5th Ave CVS overnight. CVS store #2058, the drugstore closest to the NYU core campus. Hours (Mo-Fr 08:00-20:00, Sa-Su 10:00-18:00) from pharmacy directory listings; phone (212) 982-3133.
